verified_facts.public_register: Tailte Éireann states that the Land Register is a public record and that people may inspect folios/maps or obtain copies subject to prescribed fees.
verified_facts.landdirect: Tailte Éireann states that Landdirect allows searches by location/address and identification of folio details.
verified_facts.mapping_search: Tailte Éireann states that a mapping search can identify whether a property is registered and the relevant folio number.
verified_facts.official_search: Tailte Éireann provides an official ownership-search route under LR Rule 160 / Form 89.

guardrails.boundary: Do not treat general boundary datasets as legal property boundaries; Tailte Éireann directs users to the Land Registry folio/filed plan for legal-boundary information.
guardrails.ownership: Do not infer ownership from an address without title evidence.
guardrails.historical: Current folio information does not automatically answer every historical ownership question.
